import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InterruptedIOException;
import javax.xml.parsers.ParserConfigurationException;
import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParser;
import org.w3c.dom.Document;
import org.w3c.dom.DocumentType;
import org.w3c.dom.Node;
import org.xml.sax.ErrorHandler;
import org.xml.sax.InputSource;
import org.xml.sax.Locator;
import org.xml.sax.SAXException;
import org.xml.sax.SAXNotRecognizedException;
import org.xml.sax.SAXNotSupportedException;
import org.xml.sax.XMLReader;
import org.xml.sax.ext.LexicalHandler;
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler;
import org.xml.sax.helpers.XMLReaderFactory;

/**
 * A SAX-based {@link DocumentFactory} implementation that protects against XXE attacks
 * by disabling all forms of external entity resolution and DTD processing.
 */
public class SAXDocumentFactory extends DefaultHandler implements LexicalHandler, DocumentFactory {

    protected String parserClassName;
    protected XMLReader parser;
    protected Document document;
    protected Node currentNode;
    protected Locator locator;
    protected DocumentType doctype;
    protected boolean isValidating;
    protected ErrorHandler errorHandler;

    // other methods omitted for brevity

    /**
     * Creates a {@link Document} from the supplied {@link InputSource}.
     *
     * @param is the input source containing the XML document
     * @return a parsed {@link Document}
     * @throws IOException if an I/O error occurs during parsing
     */
    protected Document createDocument(InputSource is) throws IOException {
        try {
            // Instantiate the XML reader
            if (parserClassName != null) {
                parser = XMLReaderFactory.createXMLReader(parserClassName);
            } else {
                SAXParser saxParser;
                try {
                    saxParser = saxFactory.newSAXParser();
                } catch (ParserConfigurationException pce) {
                    throw new IOException("Could not create SAXParser: " + pce.getMessage(), pce);
                }
                parser = saxParser.getXMLReader();
            }

            // Register handlers
            parser.setContentHandler(this);
            parser.setDTDHandler(this);
            parser.setEntityResolver(this);
            parser.setErrorHandler(errorHandler == null ? this : errorHandler);
            parser.setProperty("http://xml.org/sax/properties/lexical-handler", this);

            // Enable namespaces
            parser.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/namespaces", true);
            parser.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/namespace-prefixes", true);
            parser.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/validation", isValidating);

            // Disable all external entity resolution
            parser.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", false);
            parser.setFeature("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities", false);

            /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
             * XXE protection: Disallow DOCTYPE declarations and external DTDs.
             * ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
            try {
                parser.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl", true);
            } catch (SAXNotRecognizedException | SAXNotSupportedException ignored) {
                // Feature not supported by the underlying parser – ignore
            }
            try {
                parser.setFeature("http://apache.org/xml/features/nonvalidating/load-external-dtd", false);
            } catch (SAXNotRecognizedException | SAXNotSupportedException ignored) {
                // Feature not supported – ignore
            }

            // Parse the document
            parser.parse(is);
        } catch (SAXException e) {
            Throwable cause = e.getException();
            if (cause instanceof InterruptedIOException) {
                throw (InterruptedIOException) cause;
            }
            throw new SAXIOException(e);
        }

        // Reset state before returning
        currentNode = null;
        Document ret = document;
        document = null;
        doctype = null;
        locator = null;
        parser = null;
        return ret;
    }

    // other methods omitted for brevity
}
